title: Headphone, Earbud and Smart Speaker Test
seoDescription: Audio Precision headphone, earbud and headset test: APx analyzers, GRAS 45CC fixture and KEMAR, Bluetooth and USB headset testing, EN 50332.

props.title: Headphone, Earbud and Smart Speaker Test
paragraphs: Many people spend hours a day wearing speakers on or in their ears, and expect hi-fi sound from a very small package. Measuring the audio quality of headphones, earbuds and headsets reliably is demanding work for the engineers who design them.
Audio Precision analyzers with GRAS test fixtures and the APx500 software cover these measurements, including Bluetooth and USB devices.

items.title: Circumaural (around-ear)
items.text: Completely surround the pinna and rest on the head around it.

items.title: Intra-concha (in-ear)
items.text: Small earphones that rest within the concha cavity, just outside the ear canal.

items.title: Insert
items.text: Small earphones that partly or completely enter the ear canal.

items.title: Supra-concha
items.text: Rest upon the ridges of the concha cavity.
